paper_metadata.title: Effect of brazing temperature on microstructure and mechanical properties of 2D Cf/SiC and Nb joints brazed with Co–Ti–Nb filler alloy

parameters.cooling_method: cooled to 573 K at 5 K/min then furnace cooled

evidence.quote: The temperature was initially increased to 573 K at the rate of 10 K/min, and held for 30 min to make organic glue volatilized. Subsequently, the temperature further rose to 1473 K at 10 K/min and then reached the brazing temperature (1553–1613 K) at 5 K/min and kept steady for 10 min.
